title: GTA 6 Leaker Shares Alleged Final Mission Video as Leaks May End
description: Cyberleek, the leaker behind recent Grand Theft Auto 6 footage, has reportedly released what may be their final video, supposedly showing game ending scenes.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Leaker Releases Alleged Final Mission Video

The continuous flow of leaked Grand Theft Auto 6 material may finally be coming to an end. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, an online leaker known as Cyberleek—who has been releasing various footage from GTA 6 over the past few weeks—has reportedly dropped what appears to be their final video.

This latest piece of unverified footage supposedly showcases parts of the game's ending, drawing significant attention from the gaming community and various media outlets. Throughout the leaking period, these materials have circulated widely online, though their authenticity remains a subject of ongoing discussion among fans and industry observers alike.

## The End of an Unofficial Leak Cycle?

For weeks, the leaks attributed to Cyberleek have provided unexpected glimpses into Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title. With this latest video focusing supposedly on the game's concluding moments, the leaker's activity is seemingly drawing to a close.

As always, players and analysts are reminded that these unauthorized clips do not reflect the final polished product. Rockstar Games has maintained its focus on development without making official statements regarding these specific leaked assets.

## Editor's Take

Cyberleek's latest release could signal the conclusion of this particular leak wave surrounding GTA 6. While unverified footage always sparks intense community debate, it remains crucial to separate these unauthorized clips from official updates. Fans should look forward to authentic trailers and announcements directly from Rockstar Games for the definitive look at the game.
